title: backlogRemovalReadiness can say ready for a state archiveAndDeleteBacklog refuses, aborting lore init at exit 6 with half the wizard's answers unapplied
implementationNotes: Resolved as a side effect of LCLI-523's fix, not implemented separately: backlogRemovalReadiness will call planBacklogSnapshot and catch its drift refusal (symlinks/non-regular entries), which is exactly this task's gap. Working on branch fix/LCLI-523-backlog-removal-readiness-drift; will close both tasks in that PR.

Resolved as a side effect of LCLI-523's fix, as previously recorded: backlogRemovalReadiness (src/backlog-archive.ts) now calls planBacklogSnapshot(root, dir) after its existing git tracked/clean checks pass, and turns a caught LoreError (thrown on any symlink or non-regular entry under backlog/) into {ready:false, reason: <LoreError.message>} instead of letting it propagate. That is exactly this task's gap: previously a symlink read clean to both git checks (git tracks the symlink object itself, not its target) so readiness said ready:true, and only archiveAndDeleteBacklog's own planBacklogSnapshot call caught it later, aborting lore init at exit 6 mid-run with the tracker/migration already persisted.

Evidence (real repro, not the mocked git-transport tests): a real git repo with a real symlinkSync'd file under backlog/, committed and clean. Pre-fix (git stash of src/backlog-archive.ts only): backlogRemovalReadiness returned {"ready":true} even though git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- backlog was empty. Post-fix: {"ready":false,"reason":"refusing to archive through symlink \"backlog/tasks/note.md\""} -- the operator is now refused with a reason BEFORE the destructive question is even offered, so the run never reaches archiveAndDeleteBacklog's own drift refusal (and the stale 'rerun the cutover' hint this task flagged is no longer reachable via this path). Permanent test added: test/backlog-archive.test.ts 'against REAL git: a symlink under backlog/ is refused, matching what archiveAndDeleteBacklog itself would refuse'. Full suite 3199 pass/0 fail; bun run typecheck and bun run lint both exit 0.
finalSummary: Resolved as a side effect of LCLI-523's fix: backlogRemovalReadiness now calls planBacklogSnapshot and turns its symlink/non-regular-entry drift refusal into ready:false with a reason, instead of readiness saying ready:true and archiveAndDeleteBacklog aborting at exit 6 afterward. Real symlink repro, before/after. See LCLI-523 for the shared implementation evidence. PR: (to be filed).
